errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse enthält die Kategorien „überwiegend negativ“, „keine Auswirkungen“, „schwer zu sagen“, „überwiegend positiv“, „beides in gleichem Maße“ und „unter 10,45 Euro“, „10,45 Euro bis unter 12 Euro“ und „übrige Betriebe“.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the horizontal axis as the category axis; it is the value axis. It also fundamentally misunderstands the chart's structure by listing the legend items ('unter 10,45 Euro', etc.) as if they were categories on the axis, failing to recognize that this is a grouped bar chart.
The value axis is horizontal, representing percentages from 0 to 50. The vertical axis displays the categories.

The description fails to mention that the bars are grouped and have three distinct shades of blue. It does not explain that each shade corresponds to a different 'Betriebsgruppe' as defined in the legend ('unter 10,45 Euro', '10,45 Euro bis unter 12 Euro', 'übrige Betriebe'). This is a critical omission for understanding the chart.

errors.text_span: Der Balken „überwiegend negativ“ erreicht ungefähr 50 %, während der Balken „unter 10,45 Euro“ etwa 10 % beträgt. Der Balken „keine Auswirkungen“ erreicht ca. 33 %, während der Balken „schwer zu sagen“ ca. 20 % beträgt. Der Balken „überwiegend positiv“ misst ca. 15 %, der Balken „beides in gleichem Maße“ misst ca. 5 %
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly treats category groups (e.g., 'überwiegend negativ') and legend series (e.g., 'unter 10,45 Euro') as if they were single bars with a single value. Each category on the y-axis has three bars, not one. The values provided are approximations for one of the three bars in each group, but they are not identified correctly.

The description hallucinates a bar for the legend item 'übrige Betriebe' and incorrectly states its value is 0%. 'übrige Betriebe' is a data series represented by light blue bars across all five categories, none of which have a value of 0%.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in absteigender Reihenfolge ihrer Höhe oder Länge angeordnet.
errors.evidence: This statement is an oversimplification. The categories on the y-axis are sorted in descending order based on the general magnitude of the values, but the individual bars within each group do not consistently follow this descending order.
